entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I think we handled that rather well,[n]didn't we?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Especially considering the last-minute[n]arrangement of our team and all.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: So, that Shadow—it said something about[n]research.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: It mentioned salvation as well—all this[n]seems to indicate that the Palace's Ruler[n]is not in his or her right mind.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I seem to have found a map to this place.[n]Let's make good use of it.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Um... So I've only shared pleasantries[n]with Akechi-san...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Would you say this is how he normally[n]is? Like a, ah... ruthless sort of person?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: What say we save the idle chatter for[n]later and keep moving?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Unless teaming up with a "ruthless[n]sort of person" is too much for you[n]to handle.
